meta.name: core-web-vitals
meta.description: Optimize Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) for better page experience and search ranking. Use when asked to "improve Core Web Vitals", "fix LCP", "reduce CLS", "optimize INP", "page experience optimization", or "fix layout shifts".

copy.tagline: 优化网页核心指标，提升用户体验与搜索排名
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果网站加载慢、布局偏移或交互响应差
copy.tagline_en: Optimize Core Web Vitals for better user experience and search ranking
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your website has slow loading, layout shifts, or poor interactivity

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会帮你分析网页的 LCP、INP、CLS 三个核心指标，并给出具体的代码优化建议，比如预加载图片、拆分长任务、给图片加宽高属性等。
howto.when: 当你提到“优化 Core Web Vitals”、“修复 LCP”、“减少 CLS”、“优化 INP”、“页面体验优化”或“修复布局偏移”时，Claude 会触发这个技能。

say.text: 帮我优化这个页面的 LCP。
怎么减少 CLS 布局偏移？
我的 INP 太慢了，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会建议拆分长任务、优化事件处理函数等。

howto.what_en: When installed, Claude will help you analyze the three Core Web Vitals metrics (LCP, INP, CLS) and provide specific code optimization suggestions, such as preloading images, splitting long tasks, and adding width/height attributes to images.
howto.when_en: Claude triggers this skill when you mention "optimize Core Web Vitals", "fix LCP", "reduce CLS", "optimize INP", "page experience optimization", or "fix layout shifts".

say_en.text: Help me optimize LCP for this page.
How to reduce CLS layout shifts?
My INP is too slow, what should I do?
